notes.title: How invitations work
notes.flowBody: Send by email + role from the Members page; the recipient gets an email with a link. Once they sign in with the invited email and accept, they join the tenant and its default workspace
notes.expiryBody: Invitations are valid for 7 days and expire automatically; revocation is immediate. The same email can be invited again after the invitation lapses
notes.resendBody: Resending creates a new link, voids the old one immediately and restarts the 7-day validity; if the email cannot be sent, copy the link from the dialog and share it manually

invitationsPage.revokeConsequence: The invitation link stops working immediately and the recipient sees "invitation not found". This cannot be undone — re-inviting them means sending a new invitation.
